  1. Mindfulness exercises. The purpose of these is not that they are to be used whenever you want to clear your mind, but rather for you to learn how to clear your mind, so you can do it when you need to (without the exercises).

  2. Take a walk in the woods / nature. For some reason, being out in nature has a calming effect on our minds. Don't know why, but hey if it works then it works.

  3. Try disconnecting yourself from your phone and / or internet for X amount of time (everything from a few hours to a few days).
